prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE 1024×1024 square opaque PNG app icon for Lull, a calm Montessori toybox app for toddlers. Full-bleed artwork, no presentation frame.
SCENE: One big ROUND OCHRE FELT SUN #E0B866 sitting LOW behind exactly TWO soft rolling wool-felt hills. Short stitched felt rays extend from its circular edge. The round sun body fills about55% of canvas width and its LOWER HALF is concealed BEHIND the hills: clearly a half-hidden rising or setting sun, never a whole floating disc. Near hill sage green #8FA58A, far hill lighter sage #B9C9AE. The far hill is behind the near hill; their softly rolling tops remain visible as two distinct overlapping layers. Warm cream felt sky #EADFCB fills the square edge to edge behind them. Nothing else. The sun is centered horizontally, low in scene. Sun and hilltops all within central80%; hills continue naturally beyond the bottom and side edges.
MATERIAL: Handmade miniature set photographed absolutely straight-on. Soft wool felt with visible fine fibres for sky, rays, sun body and hills. Sun centre is a slightly domed thumb-smoothed MATTE MODELLING CLAY disc, same ochre #E0B866, embedded within the felt sun edge. Subtle faint finger/thumb impressions, never glossy. Short simple felt rays with restrained visible stitching in same ochre; no contrasting thread color. Soft diffuse upper-left light and small soft shadows BETWEEN material layers. Flat front camera, no perspective tilt. Texture makes it feel handmade but broad silhouettes remain clear at60pixels.
HARD RULES: One icon, exactly square1024×1024. Full bleed all4edges. Opaque, no transparent background. No rounded icon corners, outer border/frame, outer icon drop shadow, device mockup, vignette, letters/text/logos/watermarks. NO face, eyes, mouth, cheeks, clouds, stars, moon, trees or other decoration. NOT cut paper, vector, glossy plastic, shiny3D rendering or photographic outdoor scenery. Only four named pigments: cream #EADFCB, ochre #E0B866, sage #8FA58A and lighter sage #B9C9AE, with natural felt/clay texture and soft layer shading. Must read immediately at60px as a SUN half-hidden behind TWO HILLS.
status: Design candidate; not installed in app
